description: This ground-level photograph depicts a dry, hilly landscape covered by sparse vegetation. In the foreground and midground, the terrain shows yellowish-brown dry grasses interspersed with scattered evergreen sclerophyllous bushes and scrubs. These bushes are relatively low-lying, some with visible slender, woody stems, and appear adapted to arid conditions. The colour palette is muted, featuring various shades of green from the bushes and tones of brown and yellow for the dry ground and grasses. The background reveals further hills, covered by denser but visually similar vegetation, extending towards a hazy horizon under a light blue sky. The visual characteristics of the landscape are consistent with environments described as maquis, garrigue, or phrygana, typical of Mediterranean arid or semi-arid zones.
